text: dsh-blackjack 是供 DSH 网页端使用的 21 点游戏插件：它把游戏入口放在侧栏页脚，并在详情栏显示牌桌，由宿主服务维护回合状态。玩家可以开局、要牌或停牌，庄家逐步决定是否继续抽牌，最终比较点数并结算胜负；牌局采用可复现的洗牌种子，服务端将状态事件保存在会话对应的数据文件中。玩家还可以选择庄家人设并发送聊天内容，庄家会根据牌局生成决策或闲聊。适合想在 DSH 网页会话中玩一局纸牌游戏的用户；它使用 DSH 已配置的模型服务，没有单独声明的密钥配置。

dsh-blackjack brings a 21-point game to the DSH web sidebar. Start, hit, or stand as a model-backed dealer plays step by step. Seeded shuffling and per-session event files make rounds replayable; a local policy handles unavailable model routes.

我想在会话里要牌或停牌并看到牌局结果。
有没有能在 DSH 里保存牌局状态、重开后继续回放的纸牌游戏？
Can I play blackjack from the DSH web sidebar?
I want a model to deal cards and decide whether the dealer hits or stands.
dsh-blackjack 的功能「进行 21 点回合」：玩家可开始牌局、要牌或停牌；服务端按牌局阶段处理操作，并在玩家爆牌或庄家结束后结算。
dsh-blackjack 的功能「模型庄家决策」：玩家停牌后，庄家逐步作出要牌或停牌决定；模型路由不可用时使用本地规则策略。
dsh-blackjack 的功能「网页牌桌入口」：在侧栏页脚注册扑克牌入口，点击后打开详情栏中的游戏面板。
dsh-blackjack 的功能「可复现的牌局记录」：规则引擎根据种子洗牌，服务把牌局事件存入按会话区分的 JSONL sidecar，供状态重放。
想在 DSH 会话里和不同人设的庄家聊天并玩牌。
需要一款能按固定牌局种子复现发牌结果的 21 点游戏。

dsh-blackjack README · dsh-blackjack：DeepSeek-dealt **21 点 (Blackjack) for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)**. The DeepSeek model plays dealer — it deals, decides, and trash-talks as one of two selectable personas — while every round is **event-sourced** into the session log, so hands replay and fork identically. One package ships both the **host game service** and the **browser sidebar UI** (a dual-face bundle), installed in a single `dsh plugin add`.

dsh-blackjack README · dsh-blackjack：> **Install status**
> - ✅ **Complete GitHub install** (verified against `dsh web`): one package = host service + browser UI. The plugin declares both `dsh.bundle` (the host plugin row) and `dsh.client` (the web frontend entry); once installed the host layer mounts and the client module system picks the UI up into the frontend boot graph automatically.
> - All dependencies are the **published `@deepseek-ai/*` npm packages** (`0.1.0-rc.6`) — no sibling monorepo checkout, no unpublished internal packages.

dsh-blackjack README · Features：- **Two dealer personas** you pick per session (durable through `blackjack/persona` events):
  - 🐟 **大肥鱼 / Big Fat Fish** — a gluttonous, lazy deep-sea fish ("咕噜咕噜").
  - 😼 **雌小鬼 / Brat** — a smug, cheeky brat who calls you "杂鱼".
- **Model-dealt decisions**: the dealer decides hit/stand through an auxiliary LLM call, one visible step at a time.
- **Cross-round memory**: the dealer's prompts carry the running score and the shared chatter history.
- **Event sourcing**: `blackjack/game-start|hit|stand|dealer-hit|settle|banter|emotion|persona` are durable session events; the fold replays identically.
- **Graceful degrade**: with the LLM route absent or failing, the dealer falls back to per-persona preset lines.

dsh-blackjack README · Features：**Browser UI**

- A 🃏 entry in the sidebar footer opens the 21 table in the right details column.
- The table, dealer-mood badge, lifetime record, a chatter feed (dealer banter plus a staggered card-flip draw animation), and an emoji quick-bar.
- Talks to the host through a self-mounted `blackjack` Remote namespace; the UI holds no game state of its own.

dsh-blackjack README · UI preview：The screenshots below come from verified `dsh web` sessions. The exact cards, dealer lines, and record counters vary with the session log, but they show the complete browser half: the sidebar entry, the table, the chatter feed, and the action bar.

dsh-blackjack README · Install (complete: host + UI)：The plugin is a dsh **dual-face bundle** (`dsh.bundle` → `cordis.patch.yml` + `dsh.client` → `lib/client.js`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:<owner>/dsh-blackjack
```

dsh-blackjack README · Install (complete: host + UI)：A git install fetches sources, so the first `add` needs the self-contained `prepare` build allowed once — copy the pnpm key into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` under `allowBuilds` (see the [official publishing guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)) and re-run `add`. Only allow sources you trust.

Verify and boot:

dsh-blackjack README · Install (complete: host + UI)：```sh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config   # shows the "# == dsh-blackjack" layer
dsh --profile <name>                 # web surface: dsh web / dsh --profile <name> web
```

After restarting `dsh web`, a 🃏 entry in the sidebar footer means the UI is live: the host layer shows in `--dump-config`, and the client module system automatically scans the `dsh.client` declaration and weaves the UI into the frontend boot graph (`__DSH_BOOT__`) — no extra configuration.

dsh-blackjack README · Install (complete: host + UI)：Configuration (override in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: blackjack
  config:
    dealerPersona: 雌小鬼   # initial persona; the durable pick is per-session
    randomBanterChance: 0.3  # unsolicited taunt probability after a hit

dsh-blackjack README · Gameplay：Standard Blackjack over one deterministic 52-card deck (seed stored in the `game-start` event): Aces 11/1, face cards 10, hit/stand, dealer draws to ≥17. Busts lose immediately; equal totals push.
